inputs.role: style reference only: copy its line weight, rounded outlined groups, black pill sublabels, black knobs and black output box. Do NOT copy its layout, control count, text, logos or colours.

jobs.style: Style: a flat, high-contrast product illustration of a Eurorack module front panel, drawn in the visual language of the attached reference: warm bone panel #E8E6E1, bold uniform near-black outlines about 2 px, related controls grouped inside rounded rectangles with dark outlines, matte black knobs with one thin white pointer line, small black pill-shaped sublabels, one black rounded box holding the output jacks which sit in white rings, no gradients across the panel, no ornaments, only a soft contact shadow under controls. Palette: bone #E8E6E1, ink #0F1216, grey #6E7177, exactly one accent colour sea green #12C08A used only for small LEDs.
jobs.subject: Subject: the complete front panel of a very narrow Eurorack module, 4 HP (20 mm wide, 128.5 mm tall, a tall thin strip about 1:6), seen perfectly straight on, filling the whole image, no rack, no hands. One single column, two identical channels stacked: each channel is a rounded outlined group holding, from top to bottom, one medium black knob with a pill sublabel, one round input jack, one round input jack with a tiny green LED beside it, followed by a small black rounded box holding one output jack in a white ring with a tiny green LED beside it. A small blank logo area at the very top. All labels are blank short black bars and pills, no letters or numbers.

jobs.style: Style: a flat, high-contrast product illustration of a Eurorack module front panel in the visual language of the attached reference but on a dark graphite panel #17191B with light grey outlines #6B6F75, rounded outlined groups, matte black knobs with a white pointer, light pill sublabels, one near-black box for the output jack. No gradients, no ornaments. Palette: graphite, light ink #E6E8E8, exactly one accent colour sea green #2FD8A0 for small LEDs.
